# --- TUNING RESULTS ANALYSIS ---
```{r}

# 1. Loading data
data <- read.csv("tuning_results.csv")

# Removal of failed trials (Recall = 0)
clean_data <- data[data$recall100 > 0, ]

cat("Analysis on", nrow(clean_data), "valid trials.\n")

# 2. Correlations
correlations <- cor(clean_data)
cat("\n--- Correlation with Recall@100 ---\n")
print(correlations[,"recall100"])

# 3. Linear model
# Parameter influence on result (keeping the others fixed)
model <- lm(recall100 ~ threshold + max_terms + w1 + w2 + w3, data = clean_data)

cat("\n--- Parameter significance ---\n")
summary_model <- summary(model)
print(summary_model$coefficients)

# 4. Quick view
par(mfrow=c(2,3))

# Scatter plots for variables vs recall
plot(clean_data$threshold, clean_data$recall100, main="Threshold vs Recall", col="blue", pch=20)
plot(clean_data$max_terms, clean_data$recall100, main="Max Terms vs Recall", col="red", pch=20)
plot(clean_data$w1, clean_data$recall100, main="W1 vs Recall", col="darkgreen", pch=20)
plot(clean_data$w2, clean_data$recall100, main="W2 vs Recall", col="orange", pch=20)
plot(clean_data$w3, clean_data$recall100, main="W3 vs Recall", col="purple", pch=20)

par(mfrow=c(1,1))
```
